summary.tldr: Gives effect to the Final Self-Government Agreement for the Tlegohli Got’ine and makes related changes to other laws.
what_it_does: Gives legal effect to the Final Self-Government Agreement for the Tlegohli Got’ine.
Makes consequential amendments to other Acts, which are related changes to other laws.
summary.background: The Minister of Crown-Indigenous Relations introduced the bill in the House of Commons on 26 March 2026, and it received first reading.
